verdict.rationale: Several evidence items come from Egnyte's public pricing page, but every one describes a feature (sharing, e-signature, workflows, AI). None states per-plan storage quotas, per-user prices, or what happens when the storage cap is reached. Storage pricing is a fair axis for a cloud content platform, so the lack of evidence yields none, not na.

support.subject: As a founder, storage pricing is published — per-plan storage quotas and per-user prices on a public page, including what happens at the cap
